title: Vrbo Reservation Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vrbo:reservation
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by property_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>48
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Vrbo reservation data has stopped arriving for a given property.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per property and alert when the feed is older than 48 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your Vrbo reservation feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
